ON THE 6 th OF FEBRUARY, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 4515 of 2025  AJAY SAHERIYA  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri D. S. Rajawat - learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Nirmal Sharma - learned Public Prosecutor for the r  ORDER 1.

This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.234/2024 registered at Police Station Dharnawada, District Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5 /6 of POCSO Act.
2
As per story of prosecution, the allegation levelled against the applicant is that he committed rape with the prosecutrix.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that the first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 15.1.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.56460 of 2024 with liberty to renew the prayer after recording the statement of the prosecutrix.
Thereafter, the prosecutrix was examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution case and turned hostile.
She stated in her statement that she was aged about 19 years old at the time of incident and at present she is of 20 years.
Though, the DNA report is positive, but the process of taking sample is defective.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:2496 2 MCRC-4515-2025 terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of the trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the Ajay Saheriya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4908756/
1 applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
